in_hebrew.name: Harve
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Hare or army
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Harve הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English har meaning 'hare' or hari meaning 'army'. The name Harve may symbolize the agility and strength of a hare or the power and unity of an army.

in_greek.name: Harve
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Hare or army
in_greek.long_meaning: Harve είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English har meaning 'hare' or hari meaning 'army'. The name Harve may symbolize the agility and strength of a hare or the power and unity of an army.

in_latin.name: Harve
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Hare or army
in_latin.long_meaning: Harve est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English har meaning 'hare' or hari meaning 'army'. The name Harve may symbolize the agility and strength of a hare or the power and unity of an army.
